title: feat(events): list the latest replies for the ops dashboard
description: The internal ops dashboard shows the latest replies across every account. Adds `listRecentReplies(db, since)`, capped at 500 events.
rationale: `events` holds hundreds of millions of documents and every index starts with `accountId`: a filter on `type` and `createdAt` scans the whole collection and sorts in memory. The change adds no index.

extras.note: the 500 cap is the stated behaviour and the only bound on a cross-account query; the test inserts 3 replies, so dropping `.limit` stays green
`$gte` vs `$gt` is not pinned: every fixture sits far from `since`, and a polling dashboard depends on that edge
